# Honora Hollis

## Appearance

Honora is fair, blonde, ethereal-appearing, and tall, standing two inches taller than Cressida. She has a bright and radiant presence, and is described by Nell as having a soul like a golden narcissus.

_Sources: [v1 c34 P12](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0012), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c13 P70](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0070), [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v3 c4 P6](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0006)_

## Personality

Honora is contemplative, creative, and a driven scholar, yet she is thoroughly packed with mischief, jokes, and humor. She expresses a romantic, poetic nature, often voicing imaginative thoughts about life and nature. Although she possesses gravity and grave outlooks on existence, she is also lively, friendly, and practical when planning for her studies and living arrangements.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c13 P11](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0011), [v2 c13 P34](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0034), [v2 c13 P67](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0067), [v2 c13 P69](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0069), [v3 c3 P24](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0024), [v3 c5 P3](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0003), [v3 c9 P15](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0015), [v3 c9 P17](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0017)_

## History

Honora initially met Nell Harcourt at Regent's Academy, where the two quickly formed a close friendship based on shared academic and creative interests. After her schooling, she was assigned to teach at the Delford school and gave a presentation on graveyards to the Brierley Village Improvement Society. During a spring gathering with Nell, Odette, and Isolde, Honora helped choose the name 'Crystal Lake' for a local spot. Later, she attempted to arrange a visit between Nell and her aunt, the author Mrs. Charlotte E. Varley, which was initially postponed but eventually took place at Grey Shutters. Honora enrolled at Wexcombe Academy alongside Nell, where they roomed together and became friends with Cressida Lindsay. After house-hunting in Portmaris, Honora and Nell helped secure Tabby's Place to live in with Mabel Colby, Cressida, and Aunt Euphemia. She successfully completed her initial year at Wexcombe, earning Honors in Classics.
